sections.name: Spin
sections.text: Spin makes its way as the first ever spec to come to TLA. It's power will be finalized in our next update.

sections.name: Mandom
sections.text: Welcome to the true man's world. Mandom focuses on quick tactical thinking and also has our first interactable cutscene move.

sections.name: 1v1 Gamemode
sections.text: the highly awaited one versus one gamemode is here! Cash prizes are given out to winners and leaderboard players will receive even more goodies every reset!
